_readme: Company details printed on every invoice. Edit this file, not the generator. Fields left blank are NOT guessed — the generator prints a visible 'incomplete' band on the invoice until they are filled in, so a half-finished invoice can never be sent by accident.
tradingStatement: Archive Wholesale is a trading name of MANCH Ltd.

registeredOffice._note: The registered office as given by the owner, 14 Sep 2026. Companies House also carries a town line for BB8 0SD — add it here when confirmed rather than assuming it.

tradingAddress._note: Optional. Only set this if goods are despatched from somewhere other than the registered office. Leave lines empty to print the registered office alone.

vat._note: MANCH LTD is not VAT registered. Mirrors siteConfig.vat.registered in site/src/config/site.ts — flip BOTH together when registration comes through, and add the VAT number here.
vat.notRegisteredStatement: MANCH Ltd is not registered for VAT. No VAT is charged on this invoice and none is recoverable from it.

bank._note: Only used when payment.method is 'bank' or 'both'. Payment is currently by link, so these are not required and are not printed.

defaults.deliveryNote: Delivery is quoted separately once we have your address and total weight.
terms: Goods remain the property of MANCH Ltd until paid for in full.
Wholesale lots are sold as graded and described. Grades are defined at www.archivewholesale.co.uk/grading-guide.
Lots are representative of the sort described; individual garments, brands and colourways vary.
Sold as a trade supply to a business buyer. Consumer distance-selling cancellation rights do not apply.
Shortages or discrepancies must be notified within 48 hours of delivery.

payment._note: How the customer pays. 'link' = a secure payment link sent with the invoice. 'bank' = the bank details below. 'both' = show both. Only 'bank' makes the bank fields required before an invoice can be sent.
payment.linkStatement: A secure payment link is sent with this invoice.
